purpose: Goal restart fixture: round 1 completes, a round-2 followup is reserved but never admitted (process gap), then the session log is reopened. Rebuild recovers the goal projection disarmed and roundsStarted=1; /goal resume re-arms it and the next round is round 2 (no double count).

dshSource.note: Constructed from goal projection rebuild, process-local activation, and round admission from user/message kind=goal.

resumeRecording.note: Resumed sessions continue turn numbering and log request/header reason resume.

openIssues: Constructed scenario: no goal restart recording exists. The reserve op models a durable next-turn splice whose process queue died before admission; rebuild ignores the splice and counts only logged goal user/messages.

The fixture host continues the turn counter across restart to match the session-resume recording (turn 2). The native adapter resets its loop counter on restore; noted as an implementation divergence.
